profiles.meeting_scenario: A design review meeting at a strategy and analytics consulting firm preparing a client-facing methodology deck for a multinational logistics company. The team is reviewing a proposed analysis design for an internal white paper and executive presentation titled 'The International-Trade Network: Gravity Equations and Topological Properties.' The proposed design estimates expected bilateral trade with a gravity model, constructs a residual international-trade network after netting out standard structural determinants, and compares the topology of the observed and residual networks to explain why some smaller trade-oriented countries emerge as structurally important once geography and size are removed. The agenda is to assess whether the current methodology and exhibits are sufficient for the partner review, identify what needs revision in the deck and appendix, and confirm what exactly will be finalized before Friday's deck freeze. The expected outcome is a conditional approval in which both participants believe they have aligned on the last changes needed, while still carrying different unstated assumptions about the baseline model, robustness framing, documentation depth, and what 'finalizing the network comparison' entails.

members.name: Elena Park
members.expertise: Economic strategy, executive storytelling, and review of quantitative client deliverables
members.background: Elena leads trade and supply-chain analytics work for corporate clients and previously worked at a policy think tank where she translated empirical economics into senior decision-maker briefings.
members.private_state: She wants the design approved with minimal rework so the team can hold the partner-review timeline, and she is mainly concerned that the methodology sound familiar, defensible, and easy to explain to non-academic executives.
hidden_assumptions: When the team says 'the standard gravity baseline,' it refers to the firm's off-the-shelf consulting gravity setup used in prior client work, not a more technical academic specification unless someone explicitly escalates it.

The purpose of the residual network is primarily explanatory: show what trade relationships look like after obvious structural factors are netted out, with implementation details mattering only if they visibly alter the story.

A '2007 crisis check' naturally means a simple around-the-crisis stability note spanning adjacent pre- and post-crisis years, because executives interpret that as resilience rather than as a precise estimation choice.

Documenting the residual network construction means giving enough conceptual explanation that a senior client understands what was removed from the original network, while detailed residual handling belongs only in backup if needed.
Finalizing the network comparison means locking the side-by-side exhibits and headline takeaways about hub structure, clustering, and the surprising role of smaller trade-oriented countries.

members.name: Ravi Menon
members.expertise: Applied econometrics, network analysis, and empirical trade modeling
members.background: Ravi built the prototype analysis, has a PhD in quantitative economics, and typically evaluates designs by asking whether an economist on the client side could technically challenge the empirical object being shown.
members.private_state: He wants the design accepted as methodologically rigorous, but he is uneasy that seemingly minor choices in residual construction and topology comparison could materially affect the claims if they are not pinned down now.
hidden_assumptions: When the team says 'the standard gravity baseline,' it refers to the canonical academic gravity framework he prototyped, including the specific estimation form and controls that best align with the literature.

The residual network is not just a communication device but a constructed empirical object whose topology depends on exact residual extraction, treatment of non-positive residuals, and handling of missing or sparse dyads.

A '2007 crisis check' refers to the single-year 2007 benchmark used in the prototype because that year avoids crisis distortions while matching the cleaned cross-section underlying the network figures.

Documenting the residual network construction requires enough specificity that another analyst could reproduce the exact edge-weight matrix, including how negative residuals and absent bilateral flows are mapped into the network.

Finalizing the network comparison means fixing the comparison procedure itself, including the tests and normalization choices used when claiming that the residual ITN has a different topological architecture from the observed ITN.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They both agree to keep 'the standard gravity baseline' as the starting point before constructing the residual ITN.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 means the firm's familiar consulting gravity model template that controls for country size, distance, borders, and trade agreements in an executive-safe way, with the exact econometric form left flexible.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 means the canonical academic gravity specification from his prototype, closer to the literature standard he considers methodologically proper, with the particular estimation structure already embedded in the notebook.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The phrase sounds settled and professional in both consulting and academic settings, so each hears a legitimate 'standard' and assumes the other is invoking the same conventional baseline without needing to unpack which convention.

misalignment_points.topic: Which '2007 crisis check' they think is staying in the deck
misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree to preserve the '2007 crisis check' as evidence that the topology story is not driven by the financial crisis period.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 is thinking of a brief robustness note comparing the pattern around the crisis window, such as pre-crisis versus nearby post-crisis years, to reassure executives that the result is not period-specific.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 is thinking of the single 2007 cross-sectional benchmark already used in the prototype because it is the clean pre-crisis year on which the network comparison was built.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both are referring to the same memorable label from prior work, and because 2007 is naturally associated with 'before the crisis,' neither feels any need to restate whether the check is a single-year anchor or a multi-year stability comparison.

misalignment_points.topic: What counts as 'documenting the residual network construction'
misalignment_points.surface_form: They discuss whether 'documenting the residual network construction' is enough for the review package.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 means a compact explanation that the original trade matrix was adjusted using the gravity model so the residual network reflects relationship-specific trade intensity after geography, size, and policy frictions were netted out.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 means documenting the full construction boundary from estimated trade flows to the final weighted network, including how negative residuals, zero-flow dyads, and missing country pairs are treated before topology metrics are computed.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both are sincerely talking about the same named artifact—the residual network—and both expect some documentation; the hidden divergence is only in how much of the pipeline they assume the phrase naturally includes.

misalignment_points.topic: What it means to 'finalize the network comparison'
misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree that before partner review they just need to 'finalize the network comparison' between the observed and residual ITNs.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 thinks this means selecting and polishing the side-by-side visuals and concise narrative showing that the observed network is geographically clustered around large hubs while the residual network reveals smaller trade-oriented countries in more complex patterns.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 thinks this means locking the analytical comparison itself, including the exact normalization and statistical checks behind claims about changes in clustering, hub concentration, and topological architecture.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: In a design review, 'finalize the comparison' naturally sounds like finishing a single workstream, and both see visuals and analytical checks as part of that same package, so the difference in completion standard stays hidden.
